title: Russian Drones Kill Woman Near Sumy Apartment Building
detail: Two Russian strike drones hit near a block of flats in Sumy on September 21. A 38-year-old woman was killed instantly and her 41-year-old husband was hospitalized with multiple injuries. The strike damaged the residential building and five vehicles. Less than an hour later, a separate drone struck a civilian vehicle nearby, sparking a fire. Sumy Regional Military Administration head Oleh Hryhorov said the strike drones appeared to be targeting civilian infrastructure.

media.caption: Damage after Russian drones struck near an apartment building in Sumy, killing a woman, Sept. 21, 2026
